subject: Galileo AI — Marketplace listing readiness and co-sell enablement
messages:
From: Aisha Kumar <aisha@galileo-ai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Platform <platform@galileo-ai.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Apr 2029 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Galileo AI — Marketplace listing readiness + co-sell ask

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking a look — I'm Aisha, head of partnerships at Galileo AI. We're finalizing a lightweight build for our realtime embeddings connector (public beta) and want to get it listed on AWS Marketplace and GCP Partner Catalog.

High level ask: can Redwood advise on the "sell-with" / co-sell path (requirements, evidence, and timeline)? We are particularly interested in:
- Listing artifacts required (one-pager, screenshots, deployment guide)
- Evidence for security/compliance and a quick SOC2 excerpt if available
- Recommended SKU/usage mapping for co-sell (we plan to meter by monthly active model queries)

I've attached a one-pager and product screenshots for context. Would love to schedule a short call next week with partner ops + someone from your marketplace team to scope out a mutual action plan.

Attachments: galileo-product-onepager.pdf

Best,
Aisha Kumar
Head of Partnerships | Galileo AI
aisha@galileo-ai.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha@galileo-ai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Apr 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Galileo AI — Marketplace listing readiness + co-sell ask

Hi Aisha — great to meet you over email, and congrats on the beta.

Short answer: yes, we can help. Suggested next steps (quick win -> MOU):
1) Discovery call (30m) — partner ops + listing owner + product technical.
2) Evidence intake — security questionnaire + sample telemetry + basic SOC2 excerpt (if you have it).
3) SKU mapping & demo plan — we recommend a metered SKU and a co-sell playbook with joint demo artifacts.
4) Draft a lightweight MOU/enablement agreement once pricing and SKUs align.

Can Ben (copied) lead the co-sell enablement plan on our side; Karthik will advise on technical listing requirements. Are you available Tue 9th or Wed 10th PST for the call?

Ben — can you pick this up and pull together a short template for what we need from Galileo (evidence & artifacts)?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Aisha Kumar <aisha@galileo-ai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dev Platform <platform@galileo-ai.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Apr 2029 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Galileo AI — Marketplace listing readiness + co-sell ask

Thanks Grace — Tue the 9th works for us (10:30am PST). I attached the security intake spreadsheet and a short usage projection for Q2 so you have something to review ahead of the call.

Quick context for the intake:
- We are SOC2 Type II in final report stage; we can share the auditor letter next week.
- Sandbox credentials for the connector are available here: https://galileo-ai.dev/sandbox (username: redwood-eval)
- We expect 50k MAUs by end of Q2 across 3 initial accounts; projection attached.

Attachments: security_answers_v1.xlsx, usage_projection_Q2.csv

Please confirm call invite and any pre-read we should prepare. Also tagging our Dev Platform address for technical contacts on the call.

Best,
Aisha

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha@galileo-ai.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Apr 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Galileo AI — Marketplace listing readiness + co-sell ask

Aisha / Grace — thanks, confirmed for Tue 9th 10:30am PST (invite sent). I pulled together a short enablement checklist and target owners so we can be efficient on the call: 

Enablement checklist (what Redwood needs from Galileo before listing kickoff):
- Customer-facing one-pager + 2 screenshots (we have the one-pager attached from Aisha)
- Technical artifact: quickstart guide (Markdown) + sample deployment manifest
- Security evidence: security_answers_v1.xlsx + SOC2 auditor letter (when available)
- Billing mapping: suggested SKU names and metering plan (we'll propose defaults during the call)
- Joint demo script and replay recording of an end-to-end flow

Owners:
- Redwood co-sell & listing owner: Ben Carter (I'll create the draft MOU template)
- Technical checklist: Karthik Iyer (will validate manifest & sandbox integration)
- Legal / Procurement: I'll loop Legal after the call to start the MOU review (expect 5–7 business days for a lightweight agreement)

I've attached a short "enablement radar" PDF that shows the timeline and deliverable owners. Aisha — if you can drop the quickstart guide into the Drive link below prior to Tue, Karthik can smoke-test the sandbox same day.

Attachments: co-sell_enablement_radar.pdf
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GxX-galileo-evidence

Talk Tuesday — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
